name: 5-ethoxy-αMT
summary: 5-Ethoxy-alpha-methyltryptamine (5-EtO-AMT) is a tryptamine derivative closely related to 5-MeO-AMT. It has an LD50 in mice of 56mg/kg, but its pharmacology has otherwise been little studied.

uses.en: It is an obscure research compound with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種鮮為人知的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种鲜为人知的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related α-methyltryptamines such as αMT and 5-MeO-AMT can cause nausea, vomiting, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating and anxiety, and can raise the risk of serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的α-甲基色胺類（例如αMT與5-MeO-AMT）可能引起噁心、嘔吐、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高與焦慮，也可能提高血清素症候群的風險，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的α-甲基色胺类（例如αMT与5-MeO-AMT）可能引起恶心、呕吐、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高与焦虑，也可能提高血清素症候群的风险，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: It is the ethyl version of 5-MeO-AMT, differing by a single extra carbon on the oxygen. Its pharmacology has barely been studied.
fact.zh: 它是5-MeO-AMT的乙基版本，差別只在於氧上多了一個碳。它的藥理作用幾乎沒有被研究過。
fact.zhHans: 它是5-MeO-AMT的乙基版本，差别只在于氧上多了一个碳。它的药理作用几乎没有被研究过。
